<div class="dash">

<section class="tilebox c-intro">
  <div class="intro-title">Prophet Model Implementation for Digital Payment Volume Forecasting with Holiday and Event Effects</div>
  <p>We forecast daily UPI transaction volume with Prophet and test how much holidays and events improve the forecast. NPCI publishes UPI data monthly only, so the daily series is <b>synthetic</b>, built from real NPCI monthly totals (Jan 2022 to Aug 2026) with effects of known size.</p>
  <div class="who">ATSA Group 2: Rohan Dedhia, Duncan D'lima, Sanaz Katpitia</div>
</section>

        <div class="num">24 to 26 bn</div>
        <div class="bot"><span>transactions per month</span><span>Sep 26 to Feb 27</span></div>
      </div></div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="bal-label">Aug 2026 actual</div>
      <div class="bal-num">24.5 bn</div>
      <div class="muted" style="margin-top:.3rem">Peak days: 2026 sale (21 to 25 Oct) and Diwali (8 Nov), near 1 bn a day.</div>
      <a class="link-arrow" href="upi_prophet_forecasting.html">View analysis <i>&#8599;</i></a>
    </div>
  </div>
